designs.summary: Avoid per-call git rev-parse by injecting tip= or a short TTL tip cache (research/ops callers that already know tip).
designs.mechanism: snapshot(tip=...) already skips _git_tip7; optional process-local cache behind flag
designs.hypothesis: On this box, tip inject cut OBS median ~2.05ms → ~0.93ms (~55% local relative). Expect similar order when git subprocess dominates; IO remainder (cp list, pyproject) remains.
designs.measure: A/B: bench_obs_snapshot vs bench_obs_tip_inject; report median/p95 delta only
designs.risk: stale tip if cache TTL too long; default OFF; never authority for fence/consensus

designs.summary: Separate TemporaryDirectory+bootstrap setup cost from dual-claim+probe logic so hotspot attribution is honest.
designs.mechanism: reuse data_root across iterations; measure dual+probe only
designs.hypothesis: Full fence_path ~2.6ms includes ~1.3ms tmp/bootstrap; reuse-root dual+probe ~1.2ms. Further fence gains need store read coalescing — separate experiment.
designs.risk: none for production (harness-only); do not weaken dual_primary=0 asserts

designs.summary: Memoize RoutingReceipt.content_hash during verify_receipt_chain to avoid re-json+sha256 when building then verifying the same objects.
designs.mechanism: local memo dict keyed by id(receipt) inside experimental verify wrapper
designs.hypothesis: verify_only ~0.30ms for chain_len=32 is almost all content_hash; memo on second pass approaches near-zero; first-pass build still dominates (~0.7ms route).
designs.measure: A/B: verify vs verify_with_memo on same chain; also build+verify
designs.risk: memo invalid if receipt mutated after hash (receipts are append-only today)

designs.summary: Cache _list_cp_ids result or maintain tip CP pointer instead of scanning snapshots/.
designs.mechanism: mtime/size gated directory index; invalidate on CP mint
designs.hypothesis: _list_cp_ids ~0.37ms local; grows with CP count; cache should drop to <<0.1ms hits
designs.measure: microbench list_cp_ids cold vs warm after synthetic CP growth
designs.risk: stale cp_tip if invalidation missed — fail-closed: miss → rescan

designs.summary: Coalesce repeated fence_state/epoch/role JSON reads within a single probe()
designs.mechanism: request-scoped read cache inside FenceStore for one probe/claim call
designs.hypothesis: reuse-root dual+probe ~1.2ms; coalescing may cut tens of percent of remaining IO
designs.measure: instrument read counts + A/B probe latency; dual_primary must stay 0
designs.risk: stale state mid-probe if another process writes (N=2 local; document single-writer)

designs.summary: Single-pass hash of file bytes into running digest (avoid double read-write verify loop).
designs.hypothesis: packaging_verify already ~0.25ms local — low priority; expect modest relative gain
designs.measure: A/B synthetic manifest 3-file vs larger fixture
designs.risk: low; keep sha256 algorithm (no algorithm swap without design CP)

designs.summary: No improvement planned — in-memory SM ~0.002ms; noise floor.
designs.hypothesis: not a hotspot under current local harness
designs.measure: keep in run_all_microbenches as regression canary only
